about: Mutants of compiler/check/footprint, the self-hosted checker's footprint facts (CHECK-FOOTPRINTS). Killers are the footprint agreement property and checker agreement.

mutants.name: footprint-callee-opacity-dropped
mutants.rule: A frame that runs a frame of unknown footprint has an unknown footprint itself (footprint.go: a callee's Opaque joins the caller's).

mutants.name: footprint-callee-caps-dropped
mutants.rule: A frame's caps are its own and those of every frame it runs (footprint.go's join over callees).

mutants.name: footprint-own-cap-dropped
mutants.rule: A call of a capability's operation puts that capability in the calling frame's footprint.

mutants.name: footprint-scc-low-link
mutants.rule: Mutually recursive frames are one component and read one footprint (solved once per strongly connected component).

mutants.name: footprint-dies-ignored
mutants.rule: A callee that may end in a defect its body names is no dropped result (discard.go raisesByName).
